description: Header file defining constexpr parsing logic for string formatting in Abseil's internal string formatting library, including enums, structs, and parsing functions.

classes.name: UnboundConversion
classes.description: Represents a single string conversion with properties like argument position, width, precision, flags, length modifier, and conversion character.

classes.name: ConvTag
classes.description: Helper class for fast lookup and checking of conversion characters, length modifiers, and flags.

classes.name: ConvTagHolder
classes.description: Holds a static table of ConvTag entries for all possible characters.

methods.name: GetTagForChar
methods.description: Returns the ConvTag for a given character, used for parsing format specifiers.

methods.name: CheckFastPathSetting
methods.description: Checks if the conversion can take a fast path based on its properties.

methods.name: ParseDigits
methods.description: Parses a sequence of digits from the format string.

methods.name: ConsumeConversion
methods.description: Parses a conversion specifier from the format string, handling positional arguments, flags, width, precision, length modifiers, and conversion characters.

methods.name: ConsumeUnboundConversion
methods.description: Entry point for consuming a conversion specifier, determining if it's positional or not.
